claim: Exact counterexample to Theorem 4(iii), equation (7), with nonzero initial data

source.authors: Ivo Herman, Steffi Knorn, Anders Ahlen
source.title: Disturbance scaling in bidirectional vehicle platoons with different asymmetry in position and velocity coupling
source.references: Equations (1)-(5), Assumptions 2-3, Theorem 4(iii), equation (7), printed pages 14-15

model.boundary: Prescribed stationary leader; final follower considers only its forward error

singular_value_certificate.C: B^-1, the upper triangular matrix of ones
singular_value_certificate.G: C^T C, with G_ij=min(i,j) for one-based indices
singular_value_certificate.spectral_argument: D^-1 D^-T=G/4. For this positive semidefinite matrix P, lambda_max(P)^2<=tr(P^2). Thus sigma_min(D)^4>=16/155.

norm_and_taylor_certificate.argument: For the auxiliary constant-forcing solution, ||y(t)||<exp(6t)(11+6t)<=553/47<12 on [0,1/100]. This solution agrees with the truncated-force trajectory through T. Taylor's integral remainder gives F(T)>=(3/5)T-(11700/2)T^2>0.

scope: This exact proof refutes equation (7) with arbitrary initial data, which the theorem permits. It does not certify the separate zero-initial-state numerical witness, or refute asymptotic stability, passivity, or Lemma 6.
